retained_observations.detail: verify_mcp_stdio.py and verify_live_api.ps1 have no help interface, so a help-oriented probe executed their source checks. Both passed; later explicit package-bound invocations also passed, and the unexpected invocation is retained rather than recast as the planned command.

The first guard omitted parentheses around two Test-Path calls. The corrected guard then found the tracked candidate package attempt and refused to overwrite it. A new merged-main-specific path was selected and passed without changing preserved candidate evidence.
Windows PowerShell lacks System.Text.Json.JsonDocument, so the first parser stopped on the first JSON file. The native ConvertFrom-Json rerun parsed every JSON and JSONL record successfully.

One command formed safe.directory incorrectly, and the next omitted the regenerated native receipt from the expected tracked-pointer allowlist. The corrected exact check confirms only latest evaluation, dashboard, and native-receipt pointers changed; no protected source, contract, policy, or authority path changed.

Chromium emitted its known fallback task-provider diagnostic after writing the complete valid package PNG; exit status, dimensions, hashes, content assertions, state checks, and original-detail inspection pass.
